title: #1 Job Search Tip for Transferable Skills
description:
Transferable skills are one of the best ways to make your resume more appealing to hiring managers. 

Teal member Ashleigh Bergh Duggan reveals her #1 tip for adapting your transferable skills to match how a company speaks about its organization and customers.
